title: CAD Function Index — hyperCAD-S Coverage (sister to Fusion 360)
goal: Build a typed, AI-orchestrable function index for OPEN MIND hyperCAD-S that mirrors the existing Fusion360CADFunctionIndexEngine surface. Cover all 8 hyperCAD-S workspaces (sketcher, 3D solid modeler, surface modeler, healing & repair, mesh modeler, assembly, drawing, datum/reference) with per-operation parameter catalogs that the AI can search, lookup, and validate against.
ultimate_test_contribution: Without this milestone, hyperCAD-S has no machine-readable operation catalog — AI orchestrators cannot generate parameterized hyperCAD scripts, validate hyperMILL handoff (WCS / feature-recognition attributes), or answer 'what can hyperCAD do?' Pairs with the prior Fusion 360 catalog to give PRISM coverage of the two CAM-bound CAD systems we ship against.
